title: Gambas al Ajillo (Spanish Garlic Shrimp)
summary: Classic Spanish tapas of tender shrimp gently cooked in garlic-chili olive oil and served with bread for dipping.

steps.description: Pat 300g peeled shrimp very dry with paper towels. Thinly slice 7 garlic cloves, halve 1 dried red chili, finely chop 5g parsley, and slice 150g baguette.
Place 100ml olive oil, sliced garlic, and dried chili in a small skillet. Warm over low heat for 3–4 minutes until the garlic becomes pale golden; do not let it brown.
Increase heat to medium and add the shrimp in a single layer. Cook for about 1–2 minutes per side, turning once.
When the shrimp are pink and opaque all the way through, add 1/3 tsp salt and turn off the heat. Avoid overcooking.
Sprinkle over 5g chopped parsley and serve immediately with the warm garlic oil and 150g sliced baguette for dipping.
